body:
Running low on bud and with my guy or of town I headed down to my local head shop to see what they had in legal buzzes. I'm a daily smoker with an open mind and I left with a baggie of kratom and one of damiana. After reading about dosage and methods I dove in, experience follows below...
7:35pm took 1 tsp Kratom red/white using the toss and wash method
7:50 feeling normal
8:13 feeling dizzy. Ish
8:30 WOW - feels like about half a percocet... Head is pleasantly swimmy, walking accentuates the sensation.
8:45 smoked medium bowl of Damiana. Head buzz intensified. Feel very mellow, no anxiety. Smoke was sweet and fruity, very nice
9:00 overwhelming feeling of relaxation. And pleasantly dizzy. Fantastic
9:15 starting to come down, smoked another bowl of Damiana. Right back up
9:25 took another tsp of kratom.  Put on some TV, a zombie show - had me engrossed
9:55 feeling great, tiny bit itchy
10:15 warm, head is heavy and light at the same time
10:40 smoked more Damiana... Very nice. Feel stoned, but sort of heavy. I don't think I'll have any trouble sleeping. Putting on music. Feel very chatty
10:50 I'm definitely not at my sharpest... I feel a lot more impaired than from pot, I would not want to drive for instance, or write computer code (which I normally do quite well stoned) (write code that is - don't drive high)
11:05 sort of restless, like I walk around then sit down and listen to music for a minute, get back up and look at something on the computer, etc
11:55 mellowed out on the couch, pleasantly spacey.. Feel very good, no worries in the world. Coming down, but no disappointment at all. Great combo. I'll be doing this again some time. All in all, I think the kratom dominated the experience but the damiana enhanced it. Also it was more opiatey than cannabisy if I'm being honest.
